name: Kipu Health
short_description: The #1 EHR for addiction medicine and substance abuse treatment centers with comprehensive EMR, CRM, and RCM capabilities.
long_description: Kipu Health is the leading EHR platform for addiction medicine and substance abuse treatment, ranked #1 by Black Book Research in both 2025 and 2026. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Miami/Coral Gables, Florida, Kipu serves hundreds of behavioral health and addiction treatment facilities across the United States. The platform is purpose-built for treatment centers handling detox, residential treatment, outpatient programs, and medication-assisted treatment (MAT). Kipu includes comprehensive EMR, CRM for patient acquisition and admissions, and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Key differentiators include full 42 CFR Part 2 compliance for substance use disorder treatment records, MAT tracking for Suboxone, methadone, and Vivitrol, dosing protocols, pharmacy connections, and compliance monitoring. The name 'Kipu' comes from the Quechua language word for 'talking knots,' an ancient recording system.
one_liner: The #1 ranked EHR for addiction treatment and substance abuse centers.
best_for: Detox facilities and inpatient SUD programs
not_for: Solo therapists or small private practices
General mental health practices without SUD focus
Practices not requiring 42 CFR Part 2 compliance

pricing.notes: Pricing starts around $600/month and can reach $10,000/month depending on organization size. Per-provider approximately $200-$700/provider/month plus setup and migration. Multiple subscription tiers: base, billing, EMR, plus per-item fees for claims, ERAs, and reminder texts. A 400-patient practice averages ~$10,000/month for full stack.

compliance.notes: Full 42 CFR Part 2 compliance for SUD treatment records with consent management and record segmentation

integrations.notes: e-Prescribing with EPCS and MAT protocols

faqs.q: How much does Kipu Health cost?
faqs.a: Kipu pricing starts around $600/month and can reach $10,000/month for large organizations. Per-provider costs run approximately $200-$700/month plus setup fees. Multiple subscription tiers exist with additional per-item fees.

faqs.q: Is Kipu Health 42 CFR Part 2 compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Kipu is fully 42 CFR Part 2 compliant, providing record segmentation for substance use disorder treatment records and managing consent requirements as mandated by federal regulations.
